items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I’m very disappointed, I was gone by the time Joe appeared on the show and it would have been great.

ctx.x: Right. I think Joe Williams appeared on that.
Yeah, that was later on. I’m very disappointed, I was gone by the time Joe appeared on the show and it would have been great.
Well when you describe leaving that situation to go on the circuit, can you describe to me what circuit exists now for you?
